svg.title: C16-M03-F2: Rogue vs evil twin
svg.desc: The difference between a rogue AP and an evil twin and how both are detected against the inventory.
svg.text: ROGUE AP : unauthorised AP on YOUR wired network (insider/attacker bridge)
EVIL TWIN: AP impersonating your SSID on an UNKNOWN BSSID (lure clients)
both: advertise a managed SSID / sit on your net but NOT in the inventory
detect by comparing observations to the authorised-BSSID inventory
Figure C16-M03-F2. Rogue and evil-twin APs, detected via the inventory [C16-M03-R1].
